question: Mastercard on-campus Software Engineer, Technical Interview 2. The interviewer asked a design-style question: **how does a lift (elevator) work?** After the candidate struggled with the open version, it was **simplified to a single user using the lift**, which the candidate solved. Treat it as a low-level design exercise: state, behaviour and a clean model.
lookingFor: Can you simplify an open-ended problem and build up incrementally?
Do you identify entities, state and transitions (state machine)?
Is your code structure OOP-sound and extensible?
Do you handle edge cases such as invalid floors, doors and idle state?
Can you discuss how the design extends to multiple users and lifts?
followUps: How would you handle requests from several users at once?
Which scheduling algorithm would you choose and why?
How would you assign calls across multiple lifts?
How would you test the elevator logic?
